Jake Fox joins Danny Jones to ask a plain question: is time travel truly possible? The episode carries no guest claim in the title, just the question itself. Fox brings the physics and the thought tests to the table.

The two walk through what Einstein's work grants and what it bars. They weigh loops, wormholes, and the paradox of meeting your past self. Jones keeps the talk grounded in what labs can test. Listeners who love the idea get a fair tour of the real odds. The library holds the talk as an archive record for the curious.

Jimmy Corsetti and Dan Richards join the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2231. Corsetti runs the Bright Insight channel, devoted to ancient mysteries and lost history. Richards is an adventurer who has worked in Antarctica. Together they cover two of the show's favorite kinds of ground.

Corsetti lays out the ancient puzzles he is chasing, while Richards adds hard tales from the ice. Rogan moves between them, testing claims and drawing out stories. The episode mixes fringe history with first-hand endurance, a pairing that shows the range of guests the show can hold in one room.
